title: Stop choosing between AI models and ask them all with this $40 lifetime tool
excerpt: Don’t pick your favorite AI model — compare them instead.
content_html:
TL;DR: Stop tab-hopping and make the AI process a whole lot smoother with this lifetime subscription to AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan, now only $39.99 (reg. $499).

Credit: AskAnyModel

$39.99
$499 Save $459.01

Different AI models have different strengths, so why limit yourself to one or two? AskAnyModel lets you query not just a few, but over 50 AI models in one convenient spot, putting results from ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, and more at your fingertips.

Right now, you can lock in a lifetime subscription to AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan for just $39.99.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

It feels like ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and the other big models are all competing to be your go-to AI model. AskAnyModel doesn’t make you choose — instead, it gives you access to over 50 AI models in one spot… all without having to pay the individual monthly subscription costs.

Put in your prompt and see responses from six models of your choosing. The results will pop up side by side, so you can easily decide the most accurate, creative, or practical option.

Your AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan lifetime subscription means you have unlimited access to ask questions, create AI-generated images, or swap between models mid-conversation with real-time response streaming.

You’ll get 500 premium monthly credits, which give you access to 20 advanced flagship AI models that offer more powerful responses. You’ll also have unlimited use of non-flagship AI models if you don’t want to deal with usage limits.

There’s no app to download or software to deal with. You can hop on AskAnyModel on any modern web browser, anytime. It also has a continuously updated AI model library, so it’s regularly refreshed with the latest releases and improvements.
